criteria.title: Unified WorldTime
criteria.requirement: WorldTime separates epoch, logical time, simulation tick, causal sequence and historical reference.

criteria.title: Canonical Event Replay
criteria.requirement: World events append to a canonical log and replay deterministically to the same state root.

criteria.title: Fact Provenance
criteria.requirement: WorldFact and FactWorldTree retain source-event provenance and separate canonical facts from memory references.

criteria.title: Multiple Representations
criteria.requirement: One RealityObject may bind multiple rooted representations and a bounded quality portfolio.

criteria.title: Representation Flow Time
criteria.requirement: Representation flow time is distinct from historical WorldTime and is bounded by interpolation, prediction and error budgets.

criteria.title: Independent Detail Axes
criteria.requirement: Visual, physical, causal, semantic, behavioral, audio, temporal, cognitive and flow detail axes can be lowered independently.
negative_cases: physical detail silently replacing visual detail

criteria.title: Causal and Physical Levels
criteria.requirement: Causal and physical levels affect execution demand and interaction behavior while remaining candidate lowering data.

criteria.title: Horizon and Interest Cognitive Streaming
criteria.requirement: RealityHorizon and InterestGraph bound cognitive working sets without granting query or provider mutation authority.

criteria.title: Reality Query
criteria.requirement: Spatial, semantic, state, relation, temporal and permission filters form a rooted candidate query result.

criteria.title: Snapshot and Delta
criteria.requirement: RealityChunk and replication paths carry rooted snapshots, deltas, receipts and deterministic conflict inputs.
remaining: cross-host process/network partition replay is not yet evidenced
criteria.boundary: Local runtime objects and independent child-process replay; not production network replication.

criteria.title: Consistency Lease and Fencing
criteria.requirement: Two runtime nodes reject stale epoch, expired lease and stale fencing writes before canonical mutation.
remaining: network partition and production consensus proof
criteria.boundary: Independent local child processes are tested; distributed consensus and cross-host networking are not claimed.

criteria.title: Migration and Failover
criteria.requirement: Server pseudo-sovereignty can transfer a durable bundle and fence the source candidate on failover.
remaining: cross-host persistent store and production failover drill
criteria.boundary: Local durable-bundle candidate across independent child processes, not an HA consensus cluster.

criteria.title: Fiber QoS
criteria.requirement: Fiber transport profile expresses bandwidth, latency, reliability, freshness, loss mode and authority requirements.
remaining: physical Fiber link and production QoS telemetry
criteria.boundary: Profile and deterministic runtime only; no physical link execution.

criteria.title: WiFi Discovery and Roaming
criteria.requirement: WiFi-style discovery, association, roaming and fallback remain explicit candidate transport decisions.
remaining: real radio discovery, roaming and packet-loss measurements

criteria.title: Bluetooth Organ Link
criteria.requirement: Bluetooth-style low-power pairing binds device identity and capability scope without granting canonical write authority.
remaining: real Bluetooth pairing and device compatibility evidence
criteria.boundary: Bluetooth-like Organ Link candidate, not physical pairing.

criteria.title: Power Load Shedding
criteria.requirement: Power profiles and load-shedding plans protect authority, control and minimum reality before reducing soft representations.

criteria.title: Resource Governor
criteria.requirement: CPU/GPU/NPU/VRAM/RAM/storage/network/energy and simulation budgets admit or lower candidate work deterministically.

criteria.title: Faults Preserve Minimum Reality
criteria.requirement: Provider, network, GPU-memory, battery, thermal and power faults preserve a rooted minimum-reality recovery chain.
remaining: physical power/thermal sensor and OS enforcement

criteria.title: Evidence and Rollback
criteria.requirement: Roots, receipts, candidate ledgers and rollback/fencing records make candidate transitions auditable and reversible.

criteria.title: Property and Law Query Versioning
criteria.requirement: PropertySet and LawBindings expose rooted, versioned quantity and law queries for URRF lowering.

criteria.title: Dimensional Rejection
criteria.requirement: RealityQuantity rejects invalid units, dimensions and illegal arithmetic rather than silently coercing values.

criteria.title: Same Property at Two Physics Levels
criteria.requirement: A property remains one RNCS-owned semantic while causal and physical profiles change the execution level.
negative_cases: physics level changes canonical property root

criteria.title: Provider Cannot Rewrite Canonical Property
criteria.requirement: Provider materialization and prediction can emit candidates but cannot mutate RNCS canonical property or law roots.
negative_cases: canonical state root changed during materialization

criteria.title: Sensor Inference Candidate Gate
criteria.requirement: Sensor or inference-derived properties remain candidates until an explicit RNCS acceptance gate promotes them.
negative_cases: provider inference directly mutates canonical property
remaining: externally authenticated authority signature/replay and physical sensor calibration

gap.resolution: Calibrated observation, candidate inference, lease-bound RNCS acceptance and explicit canonical promotion are locally verified.

criteria.boundary: Local calibrated candidate, lease-bound synthetic RNCS acceptance and explicit promotion are verified; external authority signatures, physical sensor replay and production sensor hardware are not claimed.

criteria.title: RCL Gap versus Provider Gap
criteria.requirement: The coverage ledger distinguishes missing RCL semantic primitives from unavailable or unaudited provider/runtime capability.
negative_cases: missing RCL primitive mislabeled as runtime outage
remaining: automated donor search, K400 cell attribution and formal Integration Court

gap.policy: No silent RCL bypass; provider/runtime gaps remain auxiliary.

criteria.title: Honest Status and AAA Boundary
criteria.requirement: Every result reports bounded status and keeps AAA production blocked until external model, hardware, provenance and human evidence exist.
negative_cases: missing hardware evidence reported as pass
criteria.boundary: Current host has no CUDA/NVIDIA GPU, TRELLIS.2 weights or real Provider; AI_GENERATE and production AAA remain blocked.

remaining: network partition, multi-host restart and hardware fault drills
target-device performance budget and GPU/VRAM measurements
